title: Boot Certification Matrix
description: TODO-28 §1. The boot-platform certification matrix. Each row binds a boot promise (owner TODO) to the platforms it must pass on, the release tiers it is required for, and the machine-readable evidence a gate consumes. Shape-validated here; cross-field invariants (source_artifact required for auto/semi required rows, required_for platforms a subset of platforms) are enforced by lint.py beyond what JSON Schema can express.

required_for.description: tier -> list of platform-classes the row is REQUIRED on for that tier. Empty object = optional everywhere.

source_artifact.description: Path/name of the owner TODO's published output a gate reads to compute status (e.g. firmware-tables.json, boot-trend.json). Required for auto/semi rows that are required_for any tier (enforced in lint.py).

manual_evidence.description: For automation_level=manual rows: the evidence template/path a human attaches (e.g. boot-lab.md row). Required when a manual row is required_for any tier (enforced in lint.py).
